method: budget.xlsx was re-extracted for this round. Leaf rows only, software parents APPLHCORP, APPLBULKFUEL, APPLMARKETING and APPLSIG_ITEMS excluded, hardware parents APPLHCORP and APPLMARKETING excluded. Every rule match and every open matcher was re-implemented from its match words alone, with no reference to the claimed line lists. Row identifiers are sheet row numbers, prefixed S for the SW Line Items tab and H for the HW Line Items tab.

Rule 10 returns exactly the 12 lines and 180,000.00 on column G in the twelve stated documents with column C equal to APPLB2B, and rules 6 and 10 are exact complements over the 2,914 lines of APPLB2B. line_map plus open covers 5,157 identifiers with no duplicate and no gap, and every one of the 667 open dollar values equals column AA on its row.

Rule 4 as rewritten returns 175 lines and -16,675.01, rule 43 returns 8 and 6,254.78, rule 46 returns 3 and 109.62, and the new rules 48, 49, 50 and 51 return 1 and 1,550.05, 2 and -11,700.00, 7 and 3,903.32, and 11 and -116.52.

findings.root_cause: qa_r2_02_pairs.json defines a document as required only when its number appears nowhere in phaseb_b1 to phaseb_b4. Four documents, 5116803218, 5117334887, 5118073745 and 5119228582, carry several unrelated leg pairs each and already appeared in phaseb_b2 for one of them, so the exclusion dropped their other pairs from the required lists before the families were built. The test that matters is the family, not the document number.
findings.remedy: Cite the 5 Energy Solutions documents in phaseb_b1 rule 7 or a contra entry, the 4 Power BI Fabric documents in phaseb_b3, and documents 5118043472 and 5120370266 in phaseb_b2. Change the pair file's exclusion test from document level to family level.

The seven counterparty legs, S16462, S16577, S16667, S17020, S17101, S17270 and S17371, are all held at phaseb_b2 open B2-O18, which carries no destination. phaseb_b2 rule 15 was narrowed this issue to POWERBI and not FABRIC and holds only three lines, S16476, S16941 and S16962, at -95.60.

The two files describe the same pairs and disagree on both the holder and the destination.
findings.remedy: Restate as: against APPLH_INFOTECH in phaseb_b2 held open at B2-O18.

Rule 79 is retired and S16910 is now at phaseb_b2 open B2-O17; rule 47 is retired and H46590 is now at phaseb_b4 rule 51, open under question Q7. phaseb_b4's contra entry on document 5117738696 has a correct legs field but its note also names phaseb_b2 rule 79 for the software pair.

findings.remedy: Replace rule 79 with open B2-O17 and rule 47 with rule 51, open Q7, in both entries.
